about.title: Glendale Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Glendale sits where the Ventura Freeway meets the Golden State Freeway, and heavy daily traffic is part of life here. In 2025, the city's public records logged 727 injury collisions, 978 people hurt, and 3 traffic deaths. Three is a small number on a spreadsheet, but for the households behind each one, it is everything. A wrongful death claim in California is not about the criminal case. It is a separate civil action that lets a spouse, domestic partner, or child, and in some cases other dependents or heirs, seek compensation for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Whether the loss happened on SR-134, along San Fernando Road, or near the storefronts on Brand Boulevard, the two-year clock starts on the date of death, and it can be shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Glendale Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits who has standing to bring a wrongful death action, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, Caltrans, or another public agency may share fault. Getting connected promptly keeps those options open.

items.title: Free to you, contingency for the work
items.desc: Our connection service costs nothing, and the independent attorneys in our network take wrongful death cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on the 134 in Glendale. Does that change anything?
items.answer: It can. Collisions on SR-134 or I-5 sometimes raise questions about roadway design, signage, or maintenance, which may involve Caltrans or another public entity. When a government body is a potential defendant, California requires a formal claim on a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, so it helps to speak with an attorney soon.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution in Los Angeles County. The two cases have different goals and different standards of proof, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not the criminal case results in a conviction.

items.question: What losses can a wrongful death claim actually cover?
items.answer: California allows eligible family members to seek funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would reasonably have provided over their lifetime, and the loss of their love, companionship, comfort, and guidance. Every family's situation is different, and an attorney can walk you through how those categories apply to yours. No specific outcome can be predicted in advance.
